channel.title: Claude Code Live Cheatsheet
channel.description: Auto-updating cheatsheet for Claude Code — keyboard shortcuts, commands, tips, and more.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.220 highlights
item.description:
• Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5) added; 1M context, default Opus (v2.1.219)
  • sandbox.network.strictAllowlist denies non-allowlisted hosts without prompting (v2.1.219)
  • DirectoryAdded hook fires after /add-dir or SDK register_repo_root (v2.1.219)
  • Sub-agents nest to depth 3 by default; set SPAWN_DEPTH=1 to disable (v2.1.219)
  • Dynamic workflows default medium (<15 agents); workflowSizeGuideline setting (v2.1.219)
  • Opus 4.7 removed from fast mode; /fast applies to Opus 5 and 4.8 (v2.1.219)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.219
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] sandbox.network.strictAllowlist: Deny non-allowlisted hosts for sandboxed commands without prompting
+ [config-env] DirectoryAdded: Fires after /add-dir or SDK register_repo_root registers new working dir
+ [config-env] workflowSizeGuideline: Set dynamic workflow size guideline from any settings file
~ [skills-agents] Nesting depth: Sub-agents nest up to depth 3; set CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=1 to disable
~ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH: Nested subagent spawning; default depth 3; set 1 to disable
~ [workflows-tips] 1M context: Sonnet 5 (default) + Opus 5 + Opus 4.8 (Max/Team/Ent)
~ [workflows-tips] Dynamic workflows: Orchestrates agents; default medium (<15); triggers on 'run a workflow', 'workflow:'
- [config-env] CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.218
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [skills-agents] /deep-research [topic]: Deep research; no longer auto-invoked by Claude
~ [skills-agents] /code-review [effort]: Multi-agent bg subagent code review; no longer auto-invoked; --comment, --fix
~ [skills-agents] context: fork: Run in background subagent by default; background: false to opt out
~ [workflows-tips] Auto mode: Max & Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry; disableAutoMode; classifier adjudicates edge cases
- [skills-agents] ${CLAUDE_EFFORT}

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.217
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] emojiCompletionEnabled: Disable emoji shortcode autocomplete (:heart: → ❤️)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS: Cap on concurrently-running subagents (default 20)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH: Allow nested subagent spawning (default: disabled)
+ [keyboard-shortcuts] :shortcode:: Emoji autocomplete in prompt (e.g. :heart: → ❤️)
~ [skills-agents] Nesting depth: Sub-agents no longer nest by default; set CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH to allow
~ [cli-flags] --max-budget-usd: Cost cap; also stops background subagents when reached
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_CONTENT_MAX_LENGTH
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_AUTO_BACKGROUND_MS
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.212
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [slash-commands] /fork: Copy conversation into a new background session
+ [slash-commands] /subtask: Launch in-session subagent (former /fork behavior)
+ [cli-flags] claude auto-mode reset: Restore default auto-mode config; --yes skips confirmation
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION: Session-wide WebSearch call limit (default 200)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENTS_PER_SESSION: Per-session subagent spawn cap (default 200); /clear resets
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_AUTO_BACKGROUND_MS: MCP calls exceeding threshold auto-background (default 120000; 0=off)
~ [slash-commands] /branch [name]: Branch conversation
~ [slash-commands] /resume: Resume/switch session; agent view: picker of past sessions incl. deleted
~ [slash-commands] /btw <question>: Side question (no context); bare reopens panel; ←/→ browse answers
- [slash-commands] /logout
- [slash-commands] /powerup
- [cli-flags] claude plugin tag
- [config-env] dynamicWorkflowSize
- [config-env] vimInsertModeRemaps
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.208
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [cli-flags] --ax-screen-reader: Opt-in plain-text rendering for screen reader users
